# Every way the imported tree is allowed to differ from UPSTREAM_COMMIT.
#
# The pin used to be an unverified CLAIM. Nothing compared the imported tree
# against the SHA it names, so a resync that missed a path left the tree quietly
# not-at-its-pin -- and that is exactly what had happened: a stale bundled DMCP5
# firmware image, eleven missing example programs that the host package ships, and
# five files behind upstream. check-imported-tree-pin.py now enforces the pin, and
# this file is the reviewed exception list it reads.
#
# Entries are UPSTREAM-relative paths (the spelling upstream uses), matching every
# other ledger here -- see upstream_paths.py for why.
#
# [not-carried]     z47 deliberately does not import this path at all.
# [patched]         z47 maintains a deliberate divergence in this file.
# Both accept a literal path or a directory prefix.

[not-carried]
# Published application notes and their sources: 101 MiB, two thirds of the whole
# tracked tree, read by nothing in the build or CI. Read them upstream.
docs/appnotes
# Hardware-lab and benchmark harnesses: bench rigs for physical DM42 units.
tools/hwtest
tools/bench
# Upstream's own helper scripts and generator, superseded by z47's build.
res/SCRIPTS
src/generateTests
# Upstream's runtime PROGRAMS/ working directory at ITS repo root, not the
# packaged res/PROGRAMS library. z47 gitignores /PROGRAMS as a runtime output.
PROGRAMS
# z47 has its own README, and git honours these three only at the repo root, so
# they live there as hand-reconciled z47-owned files instead.
README.md
.gitattributes
.gitignore
.gitmodules
# Derived archives and placeholders: testPgms.zip is built by upstream's Makefile
# and regenerated by z47's own dist pipeline; the rest are empty markers.
res/testPgms/testPgms.zip
res/dmcp/.gitkeep
subprojects/packagefiles/gmp-6.2.1/.gitkeep
dep/jimtcl

[patched]
# The cov probes live in upstream's funcTestNoParam table, so they cannot be
# overlaid from a separate file. 3-way merged every resync.
src/testSuite/testSuite.c
# z47's plot-regression coverage cases, added to upstream's corpus file.
src/testSuite/tests/graphs_cov.txt
# z47 hardening: upstream's readelf parser indexes fields without bounds checks
# and crashes on section tables this toolchain emits.
tools/size.py
# Regenerated from source by z47's build (the update_testpgms step), so it is a
# build product that happens to be tracked inside the imported tree.
res/testPgms/testPgms.bin
# FontCreator project sources for the two z47-maintained fonts, added here rather
# than upstream. Already a reviewed exception in source-ownership.txt.
res/fonts/FontCreator15 Home details
